about.title: About Fredrick G. Turner, Jr., CPA
text: Since founding Fredrick G. Turner, Jr., CPA, LLC in 2016, I’ve had the privilege of offering tailored tax, accounting, and professional services to individuals, businesses, and non-profit organizations. With over 18 years of experience, much of my career has been rooted in the oil and gas industry, where I’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse range of clients—from startups to large enterprises.
